dod_intent_evidence: DoD intent is overwhelming — AFWERX TACFI award (9.17.25), a Phase II SBIR on multi-static radar (9.17.25), $10M cleared for radar development at Eglin AFB (9.18.25) — but the same newsroom shows they have already crossed the valley: 'CHAOS Industries Selected for U.S. Army G-TEAD Marketplace, Expanding Counter-UAS Support to U.S. and NATO Forces... Addition to the marketplace satisfies competition requirements and enables rapid acquisition of CHAOS systems across U.S. and NATO commands' (12.16.25).
score_evidence: 'Army Adds CHAOS Industries' Radar Technology To Acquisition Marketplace' (Defense Daily, 12.16.25) -> on an Army rapid-acquisition vehicle, which is the transition Barry sells
'CHAOS Industries Raises $510 Million Led by Valor Equity Partners' at a $4.5 billion valuation (11.13.25) -> no period-of-performance or runway pressure, and far outside the $5M-$10M band

'CHAOS Industries Names George J. Tenet as Executive Chairman' (4.8.25) and Will Hurd as Chief Strategy Officer (10.29.24) -> the acquisition advocacy chain is already staffed at the highest level available
'Insta and CHAOS Industries Partner to Counter Rising Aerial Threats in Europe' (7.2.26) plus 244 employees -> fielding partnerships and scale already in place
Product page reads 'Expeditionary / Low SWaP' and 'Interoperability with larger command and control (C2) systems' -> deployment-fluent language, the profile that scores low even when kept
what_they_do: Builds coherent distributed multi-static radar networks (Vanquish, Astria) for counter-UAS and long-range air surveillance, now on the Army's G-TEAD acquisition marketplace for US and NATO commands.
